shared_elements: human figure standing/striding in profile-ish pose with legs apart
horizontal band of repeated marks along the top
weapon or long implement held by a figure
justification: Both show anthropomorphic figures with legs apart alongside a spoked wheel/disc motif and a horizontal band of repeated marks running across the top, which is a modest but non-trivial coincidence. However, A is a dense naturalistic narrative relief of chariots, horses, archers and captives with modelled anatomy and detail, while B is a single hugely simplified stick-like figure with a plain outlined body and a disc held aloft, with no animals or narrative context and utterly different proportions and rendering conventions.
